_comment: Exemptions for bin/mcp-write-receipt-guard.py — agent-callable writes that are
allowed to answer with more than a receipt. Every entry needs a REASON, and the
reason is the review. The guard fails on a blank reason, on an entry naming an
operation that is no longer agent-callable, and on an entry over a route that no
longer breaks any rule — so this list can only shrink by fixing routes.
"rules" names WHICH rules the entry excuses, and the guard holds it to exactly
that set in both directions: a rule the route no longer breaks fails, and a rule
it breaks that is not listed fails. That is not bookkeeping — it is what stops a
DELETED rule from hiding behind a standing exemption, which is exactly how this
guard stayed green through `if False:` before T-133 added the second rule name.
